name: hireme
description: Startups with 50 or fewer people meet developers. No recruiters.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.demo: npm run build && cd server && rm -f data/demo.db* && npm run demo && DB_PATH=./data/demo.db ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@hireme.example node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/index.js
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web run lint
